task: Audit Mercado Pago paid-state reconciliation and exactly-once ticket fulfillment
evidence: Mercado Pago webhook validates signature before reconciliation and resolves the active application from the persisted payment app_id.
reconcilePaymentId scopes the local payment to ApplicationContext and verifies remote payment id, external_reference/order public_id, amount, and split application_fee before approving.
syncPayment locks payment and order rows in one DB transaction; ticket passes are created before paid state is exposed, and retries issue only quantity minus already-issued passes.
Paid order is not exposed until every ticket line has the required EventPass count; incomplete fulfillment throws and rolls back the transaction.
ReconcilePaymentsCommand independently detects paid orders with missing passes, retries fulfillment, records recovered GMV, and emits explicit unresolved-fulfillment/failure telemetry.
EventPass creation side effect only marks interest; paid notifications/email remain gated by confirmPaidOrder requiring order.status=paid.

No code change was made because this audited P0 path already contains the required idempotency and paid-before-fulfillment protections; manufacturing a change here would add risk without protecting revenue.
